option_relations.rationale: Pacemaker lead-associated thromboembolic stroke is not directly related to the provided L2 leaves.
Large vessel occlusion stroke (middle cerebral artery atherosclerosis) is not directly related to the provided L2 leaves.
Acute ischemic stroke (cardioembolic origin secondary to atrial fibrillation) is equivalent to Cardioembolic Stroke.
Large middle cerebral artery territory embolic stroke is a subtype of Cardioembolic Stroke.
